For the State : Mrs. Priya Shrestha, Spl. P.P.
-----
02/ 09.06.2025
Heard the parties at length.

2. This anticipatory bail application under Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita
(Bnss), 2023, has been preferred by the petitioner apprehending his arrest, for offences under
Sections 420, 406, 467, 468, 471, 385, 504, 506 and 120B Ipc.
3.
Learned Spl. P.P. representing the State opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail.
4.  The allegation against this petitioner is that he was a contractor who engaged the informant and others as labourer but did not pay their full wages.
Since some wages remained due, the instant criminal case has been filed under the aforementioned Sections.
5. Considering the nature of allegation which is of non- payment of part wages, I am inclined to enlarge this petitioner on anticipatory bail.
6. Accordingly, this Anticipatory Bail Application stands allowed.

The petitioner, above named, is directed to surrender 2025:JHHC:14865 before the learned court below within three weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this order and on the event of his surrender or arrest
, he shall be released Ramlal Chaudhary @ Ramlal Choudhary vs The State Of Jharkhand.
